term: present decision record and entire modeled reason-response map
definition: observe includes the selected actual ChoiceContext.History at review=external=false, reason=true and imposed=false, plus the entire Bool-to-Bool reason-response function at that acquired selector and constraint status. It omits the acquisition function. Adding that function provides the enriched data control. AdmitsCriterion retains its existing arbitrary Prop-valued exact-classifier meaning, with the intervention predicate as the classified property rather than a normative correctness or justification claim.
